fields.description: Issue includes editorials and humor columns on post-election South Florida conditions and the start of the winter season, focusing on sharply rising rents in Miami-area communities and their effects on tenants and visitors. Additional pieces discuss tourism and entertainment/nightlife, Prohibition-era liquor enforcement and local commentary, harbor safety concerns about gasoline boats and the need for a fire boat, local civic and public health notes, and transportation items including rail service and crossings. Contains club and theater listings and local advertisements.
